已查到可引用的部分資料：

To compare our Signaling / Non-signaling Tester solution with a competitor for Wireless Communication, we need a cited source that directly connects the technical capability and the competitor comparison; separate co-mentions are insufficient [40].
For our signaling side, use formal R&S CMX500 specifications/features to support claims such as LTE, NR FR1, NR FR2, NSA, SA, FDD, TDD, fading, and RF parametric testing support [2].
For CMX500 signaling feature claims, use the CMX500 features source for NR FR1/FR2 signaling, LTE signaling, NB-IoT/NB-NTN signaling, WLAN signaling, fading, BLER, CSI report, throughput, PER, application test, IP traffic analysis, and remote-control capabilities [1].
For our non-signaling or production-oriented tester claims, use formal product evidence such as CMP180 being a Radio Communication Tester for production / wireless communication device testing with multiport RF generator/analyzer, measurement options, waveform options, and VSE analysis capability [19].
For CMP180 hardware/performance claims, use formal CMP180 specifications showing simultaneous receiver and transmitter testing and optional multiport RF generator/analyzer architecture [20].
For competitor-side claims, use competitor official datasheets, configuration guides, order/configurator data, service terms, conformance/accreditation reports, or other cited third-party evidence rather than only R&S battle cards, because the Keysight battle-card language says “only,” “fully integrated,” scalability, and TCO claims require formal datasheet, features document, conformance report, or configurator verification [28].
For Anritsu comparisons, do not rely only on the R&S battle card for FR1 bandwidth, FR2 instantaneous bandwidth, FR3/RFU18 headroom, or data-rate numbers, because those are marked as sales claims at a different evidence level than formal CMX500 specifications [32].
For Amarisoft comparisons, do not present support, FR2, conformance, production-path, or other competitive claims as verified unless backed by official or third-party evidence, because the Amarisoft comparison table notes the battle card does not cite third-party or Amarisoft official documents for some claims [12].
For FR3/RFU18-related comparisons, obtain RFU18 datasheet/configurator evidence before making binding specification claims, because current sources lack RFU18 order number, formal specs document number, release date, supported configurations, bandwidth, throughput, MCS index, software release, and measurement conditions [17].

R&S CMX500 vs amarisoft › 核心 thesis
依 [[2026_02_CMX500_Amarisoft_Sales_Battle_Card]]（2026-02-26），R&S 對 [[amarisoft]] 的核心定位是：[[R&S CMX500]] 與 R&S radio communication tester portfolio 提供 instrument-grade、validated、calibrated、可延伸至 production 的 5G testing path；[[amarisoft]] 則被描述為 COTS hardware + software-defined stack 的 functional testing solution。

R&S CMX500 vs amarisoft › Sales landmines
[[2026_02_CMX500_Amarisoft_Sales_Battle_Card]] 建議用以下問題區分需求：

1. 是否需要 calibrated [[FR2]] / [[mmWave]] testing？
2. 是否需要 global support、multi-year warranty 或 calibration services？
3. 是否需要 [[Operator Acceptance]]、[[Conformance Testing]] 或 pre-conformance？
4. 是否需要 validated / [[PTCRB]] / [[GCF]] aligned test cases，而不只是 functional simulation？
5. 是否需要 non-signaling ATE 或 multi-port production test？
6. 是否需要 integrated [[Wi-Fi signaling]]（6/6E/7）？
7. 是否需要 factory line 的 non-signaling test capability？
8. 是否需要 3GPP RF pre-conformance 或 aligned test coverage？

R&S CMX500 vs Anritsu › Sales landmines
[[2026_02_CMX500_Anritsu_Sales_Battle_Card]] 建議用以下問題區分需求：

1. 是否需要 FR1 bandwidth beyond 400 MHz，例如 600–800 MHz per carrier for 5G-Advanced Rel-18 / Rel-19 testing？
2. 是否需要 FR1、FR2、FR3、WLAN 與 LTE 在 single instrument 中且不用 hardware swaps？
3. 是否需要 native fading with high-throughput IP testing？
4. 是否偏好 one unified software platform，而不是 four separate tools？
5. 是否需要 advanced CA 或 mobility without adding extra boxes？
6. 是否需要 FR3 testing beyond 16 GHz，以支援 emerging 6G FR3 evaluations？

R&S CMX500 vs Anritsu › 對比表
| 主題 | R&S / CMX500 positioning | Anritsu positioning | 來源限制 |
|---|---|---|---|
| 架構 | one-platform architecture；FR1 + FR2 + FR3 + Wi-Fi + RF + fading | multiple RF boards、external converters、multiple boxes；另依 [[mx844030pc-j1200]]，[[Anritsu MX844030PC]] 是 software-based [[Virtual Signalling Tester]]，可用 MAC / PHY Digital-IQ / RF interfaces | battle card 未提供正式 CMX500 RFU18 或 Anritsu module datasheet；MX844030PC brochure 未提供 CMX500 比較資料 |

| Fading | integrated / native fading | external PC software / chambers / software | source 未列 option code 對照 |
| IP throughput | native high-throughput IP testing | IP Option 012 + external PC | source 未列 throughput profile 或測試條件 |
| Software | single workflow / unified automation / Test Automation Suite | Battle card says SSNR + RTD + ATS + MX844030PC；[[mx844030pc-j1200]] says MX844030PC uses common RTD GUI for protocol test case transfer | battle card 是 R&S sales framing；Anritsu brochure 是 MX844030PC official product framing，兩者不可直接合併成單一事實 |
| WLAN | cellular + Wi-Fi in one platform；Wi-Fi 6 / 6E / 7 signaling inside CMX500 | MT8000A no WLAN；requires [[Anritsu MT8862A]] | CMX500 WLAN 需回查 [[CMX500_Features_CSW9-20-0_en_32]] |

R&S CMX500 vs Anritsu › 核心 thesis
依 [[2026_02_CMX500_Anritsu_Sales_Battle_Card]]（2026-02-26），R&S 對 Anritsu 的核心定位是：[[R&S CMX500]] 提供 single integrated platform，涵蓋 FR1、FR2、FR3、fading、IP throughput、NTN、Wi-Fi、RF analysis 與 signaling；相對地，[[Anritsu MT8000A]] 被描述為需要多 RF boards、external mmWave converters、multiple boxes、external PC / tools 與 fragmented software ecosystem。

FR3 測試與 RFU18 battle card 主張 › 來源主張
- 來源說 [[Rohde & Schwarz]] 與 [[Qualcomm Technologies]] successfully validated high-throughput performance of a [[5G NR]] connection at **13 GHz**。
- 來源明示 proposed [[FR3]] frequency range 為 **7.125 GHz to 24.25 GHz**。
- 來源說 [[Qualcomm Technologies]] 的 5G mobile test platform（MTP）使用 [[R&S CMX500 OBT]] in a maximum throughput use case at 13 GHz。
- 來源稱該 achievement confirms the potential of [[FR3]] to deliver high data rates using high [[MCS]]，並透過 [[4x4 MIMO]] enhanced capacity。
- 來源未提到 [[RFU18]]，也未提供 [[R&S CMX500 OBT]] 的 13 GHz hardware / software configuration。

依 [[Rohde & Schwarz demonstrates FR1–FR3 carrier aggregation, advancing 6G readiness]]（來源未標示 published date；raw created 2026-09-11；demo 日期 March 2 to 5, 2026）：

- 來源說 [[Rohde & Schwarz]] 與 [[Qualcomm Technologies]] successfully demonstrated carrier aggregation across [[FR1]] and [[FR3]] frequency ranges。
- Demo 聚合約 **2.5 GHz** [[FR1]] channel 與約 **7 GHz** [[FR3]] channel，兩 band 均使用 [[4x4 MIMO]] 與 higher-order modulation。
- Test setup 核心是 [[R&S CMX500]] one-box signaling tester，extended with new [[RFU18]] board to provide coverage up to **18 GHz**。
- 來源稱 [[RFU18]] is a modular hardware upgrade for the [[R&S CMX500]] platform，讓 existing testers extend towards [[6G]]。

R&S CMX500 vs Keysight › Sales landmines
[[2026_02_CMX500_Keysight_Sales_Battle_Card]] 建議用以下問題區分需求：

1. 要覆蓋 FR1、FR2、Wi-Fi 7、RedCap 與 NTN 時，需要多少 UXM models，且誰負責 integration？
2. 是否需要 integrated fading、Doppler 與 satellite mobility in one box，或能接受 RaySim / Channel Studio / ProbSim 等 external tools？
3. 是否需要 one unified automation environment，而不是 six separate tools？
4. 是否需要 Wi-Fi 6 / 6E / 7 on every test configuration？
5. 是否需要 validated 3GPP NR-NTN conformance（RF + RRM + PCT）with ecosystem partner，以因應 operator 或 certification pressure？
6. 轉向 FR3 時，是否要 upgrade same platform（例如 add an RF unit），或導入 new boxes and new software？
7. RedCap testing 是否要在 main 5G signaling tester 中，或能接受 separate RedCap-only box？
8. Operators 或 certification bodies 是否要求 specific timeline 上的 validated NR-NTN conformance？
9. 團隊需要學習與維護多少不同 software environments，且 tool updates 是否會破壞 automation？

R&S CMX500 vs Keysight › 核心 thesis
依 [[2026_02_CMX500_Keysight_Sales_Battle_Card]]（2026-02-26），R&S 對 Keysight 的核心定位是：[[R&S CMX500]] 提供 one-platform integration，涵蓋 cellular FR1 / FR2 / FR3 path、Wi-Fi、fading、IP/application testing、NTN、RedCap、RF analysis 與 signaling；相對地，Keysight 被描述為依賴 multiple UXM SKUs、add-on software 與 external tools。

R&S CMX500 vs Keysight › R&S offensive plays
依 [[2026_02_CMX500_Keysight_Sales_Battle_Card]]：

- **One-Box FR1 + FR2 + WLAN + Fading + IP + NTN + RedCap**：將 [[R&S CMX500]] 定位為 unified system；對比 Keysight 需要 E7515P / E7515B / E7515E、E7515W、E7515R、RaySim / Channel Studio 與 additional tools。
- **FR2 / NTN Conformance Leadership**：主張 CMX500 有 50 GHz mmWave (RRH evo)、FR2 maturity、first validated 3GPP NR-NTN conformance with Samsung、RedCap via OBT-Lite。
- **WLAN in Every Configuration**：主張 CMX500 可在每個 configuration 中整合 Wi-Fi 6 / 6E / 7 signaling；對比 Keysight Wi-Fi 只在 E7515W 或 E7515P。
- **FR3 / 6G on One Platform**：主張 CMX500 可透過 [[RFU18]] 與 6G-relevant testing 演進，包含 AI-CSI feedback、satellite Doppler、NTN mobility、FR3 channel models；對比 Keysight multi-component approach。
- **Unified Automation**：將 CMsquares、CMsequencer、CONTEST、AI Script Assistant 定位為 one unified environment；對比 Atlas、Channel Studio、RaySim、WLAN-specific tools、Nemo、UXM-specific application features。
- **Simplify the Message**：以 fewer boxes、fewer SKUs、more capability、lower TCO 作為 sales headline。

2026_02_CMX500_Keysight_Sales_Battle_Card › Battle card 中的 R&S positioning
來源的 positioning statement 主張：

- [[Rohde & Schwarz]] delivers the industry’s only fully integrated platform for FR1、FR2、Wi-Fi、fading、IP throughput、RF analysis、NTN、RedCap and end-to-end signalling in one instrument。
- 來源說 [[Keysight]] spreads equivalent capabilities across multiple UXM models、add-on software and external tools。
- 來源說 R&S ensures long-term scalability、measurement accuracy and path from R&D to certification without hardware fragmentation。

使用限制：以上是 sales language；其中 only、industry’s only、fully integrated、long-term scalability、lower TCO 等敘述不能當作可驗證規格，需回查正式 datasheet、features document、conformance report 或配置工具。

2026_02_CMX500_Keysight_Sales_Battle_Card › 重點摘要
- 來源將 [[Keysight]] 描述為大型美國 test & measurement vendor，總部在 Santa Rosa, California, USA，員工數約 **16,800+**，在 semiconductor、aerospace / defense、cloud 與 wireless testing 具有強市場存在。
- 來源主張 [[Keysight]] mobile communications strategy 越來越 software-led 與 AI-driven，但 [[Keysight UXM]] portfolio 分散於多個 hardware SKUs：[[Keysight E7515P]]、[[Keysight E7515W]]、[[Keysight E7515B]]、[[Keysight E7515E]]、[[Keysight E7515R]]。
- 來源列出 [[Keysight]] portfolio 包含 UXM 5G Wireless Test Platforms、[[ProbSim]] channel emulators、[[Nemo]] field test tools、[[RaySim]] digital twin engine、[[Atlas]] AI-powered device test、C-V2X 與 cybersecurity tools。
- 來源把 R&S positioning 表述為：[[R&S CMX500]] 在 one instrument 中整合 [[NR FR1]]、[[NR FR2]]、[[Wi-Fi]]、[[Fading]]、IP throughput、RF analysis、[[NTN]]、[[RedCap]] 與 end-to-end signaling；而 Keysight 需分散於多個 UXM models、add-on software 與 external tools。
- 來源主張 [[R&S CMX500]] 的差異化包含 one-platform architecture、integrated fading + IP + application testing、unified software ecosystem（[[CMsquares]]、[[R&S CMsequencer]]、AI Script Assistant）、measurement leadership、FR3 / 6G path、cellular + Wi-Fi in one platform，以及 NTN / RedCap / operator certification leadership。
- 來源對 [[Keysight]] 的弱點敘述包含 hardware fragmentation、multi-tool workflow、advanced testing external dependencies、limited legacy、Wi-Fi only on selected models、FR3 / 6G roadmap relies on add-ons。
- 來源的 quick comparison table 將 R&S / CMX500 描述為 one platform：FR1 + FR2 + FR3 + WLAN + fading + IP + NTN + LTE + RedCap；將 Keysight 描述為 multiple UXM SKUs + external tools。

2026_02_CMX500_Anritsu_Sales_Battle_Card › 實體
- [[R&S CMX500]] — 來源主角；被定位為 integrated platform for FR1、FR2、FR3、Wi-Fi、fading、IP throughput、NTN、RF analysis 與 signaling。
- [[Anritsu]] — 競品公司；來源描述為 Japanese test & measurement vendor。
- [[Anritsu MT8000A]] — 來源描述為 Anritsu 5G NR FR1/FR2/FR3 測試平台，但需要多 RF boards、multiple boxes、external PC / tools。
- [[Anritsu MD8475B]] — 來源描述為 LTE / IMS / eCall solution。
- [[Anritsu MT8821C]] — 來源描述為 LTE / LTE-A / 3G / 2G RF solution，且 source 說 LTE RF still needs MT8821C。
- [[Anritsu MT8862A]] — 來源描述為 Wi-Fi tester；source 說 MT8000A 無 WLAN signaling，需獨立 MT8862A。
- [[Anritsu MT8852B]] — 來源描述為 Bluetooth tester。
- [[R&S CMW500]] — source 將它放在 R&S lifecycle 中，用於 2G/3G continuity / legacy RF。
- [[R&S CMP180]]、[[R&S CMP200]]、[[R&S CMW100 K06]] — source 將它們放在 R&S production test path。
- [[RFU18]] — source 稱 upcoming RFU18 提供 FR3 beyond 16 GHz / up to 18 GHz headroom；來源未提供正式規格文件。

- 來源稱 R&S CMX500 支援 FR2 up to 50 GHz；既有 [[CMX500_specs_en_5216-4127-22_v1100]] 對 [[R&S CMXHEAD50]] / [[R&S CMXHEAD50-Evo]] 列出 **21.84 GHz to 50.20 GHz**，方向一致。
- 來源稱 R&S CMX500 有 integrated Wi-Fi signaling；既有 [[CMX500_Features_CSW9-20-0_en_32]] 已列 WLAN signaling / measurements，包含 802.11ax、802.11be 與 2.4 / 4 / 5 / 6 GHz bands，方向一致。
- 來源稱 [[R&S CMW500]] 用於 2G/3G continuity；既有 [[CMW_dat-sw_en_5213-9211-22_v1700]] 已列 GSM、WCDMA、LTE、NR Sub-6GHz、Bluetooth、WLAN 等 CMW wireless standards，方向一致。
- 來源把 [[R&S CMP180]]、[[R&S CMP200]] 與 [[R&S CMW100 K06]] 放在 production path；既有相關產品頁也將 CMP180、CMP200、CMW100 K06 描述為 production / manufacturing / nonsignaling 測試相關平台，方向一致。
- 來源中的 FR1 bandwidth、FR2 instantaneous bandwidth、FR3 / RFU18 headroom 與 data rate 數字屬 battle card sales claim，與既有正式 CMX500 specifications 層次不同；已在 [[FR3 測試與 RFU18 battle card 主張]] 標註矛盾 / 使用限制。

2026_02_CMX500_Anritsu_Sales_Battle_Card › 重點摘要
- 來源將 [[Anritsu]] 描述為長期經營的日本 test & measurement vendor，總部位於 **Kanagawa, Japan**，全球員工約 **4,000+**，在日本 T&M market share 被稱為 #1，但全球 footprint 較弱。
- 來源稱 [[Anritsu]] mobile test portfolio 是 fragmented、multi-hardware architecture，用於 [[4G]] / [[5G]] / [[6G]] testing。
- 來源列出的 Anritsu 產品組合包含 [[Anritsu MT8000A]]（5G NR FR1/FR2/FR3）、[[Anritsu MD8475B]]（LTE/IMS/eCall）、[[Anritsu MT8821C]]（LTE/LTE-A/3G/2G RF）、[[Anritsu MT8862A]]（Wi-Fi）與 [[Anritsu MT8852B]]（Bluetooth）。
- 來源稱 [[Anritsu MT8000A]] 需要 separate RF boards for FR1/FR2/FR3、external mmWave converters，並列出 boards 021/022/023/024/031/032/033；後文 weakness 另列 041，兩處 board list 不完全一致。
- 來源稱 Anritsu new FR3 option / module 覆蓋 **0.4–16 GHz**，並認為它相較 R&S upcoming [[RFU18]] / 18 GHz headroom 有 future-proofing 限制。
- R&S positioning statement：[[R&S CMX500]] 被定位為 single integrated platform，涵蓋 FR1 + FR2 + FR3、fading、IP throughput、NTN、Wi-Fi、RF analysis 與 signaling；Anritsu 被描述為需要 RF boards、external mmWave converters、multiple boxes 與 fragmented software tools。
- 來源列出的 R&S differentiators 包含 one-platform architecture、integrated fading + IP throughput、unified software ecosystem、FR2 / FR3 performance leadership、cellular + Wi-Fi single platform，以及 R&D → conformance → production path。
- 來源的 sales landmines 聚焦在 FR1 wideband beyond 400 MHz、FR1+FR2+FR3+WLAN+LTE one-box、integrated fading + IP load、unified software、multi-cell / CA / mobility without extra boxes，以及 FR3 frequency headroom beyond 16 GHz。
- 來源的 R&S offensive plays 包含 one-box FR1 + FR2 + FR3 + WLAN + fading + IP、FR2 / FR3 performance leadership、integrated WLAN signaling、R&D → conformance → production lifecycle、future-proof RedCap / NTN / ORAN / 6G、unified software ecosystem，以及 fewer boxes / lower TCO / higher throughput 的簡化訊息。

Anritsu MT8000A › Battle card 中的定位
依 [[2026_02_CMX500_Anritsu_Sales_Battle_Card]]（2026-02-26），[[Anritsu MT8000A]] 被列為 Anritsu mobile test portfolio 的 5G NR FR1 / FR2 / FR3 平台，但 source 認為其架構 fragmented：

- 需要 separate RF boards for FR1 / FR2 / FR3。
- FR2 OTA、high CA 與 mobility cases 可能需要 multiple MT8000As。
- FR2 使用 external mmWave converters。
- IP throughput 需要 IP Option 012 + external PC。
- Fading 需要 external PC software / external setup。
- WLAN signaling 不在 MT8000A 內，需 [[Anritsu MT8862A]] 作為 separate WLAN tester。
- Legacy LTE RF 仍需 [[Anritsu MT8821C]]。

CMX500 NTN one-box tester › 來源定位

To compare our Signaling / Non-signaling Tester solution with a competitor for Wireless Communication, we need a cited source that directly connects the technical capability and the competitor comparison; separate co-mentions are insufficient [40].
For our signaling side, use formal R&S CMX500 specifications/features to support claims such as LTE, NR FR1, NR FR2, NSA, SA, FDD, TDD, fading, and RF parametric testing support [2].
For CMX500 signaling feature claims, use the CMX500 features source for NR FR1/FR2 signaling, LTE signaling, NB-IoT/NB-NTN signaling, WLAN signaling, fading, BLER, CSI report, throughput, PER, application test, IP traffic analysis, and remote-control capabilities [1].
For our non-signaling or production-oriented tester claims, use formal product evidence such as CMP180 being a Radio Communication Tester for production / wireless communication device testing with multiport RF generator/analyzer, measurement options, waveform options, and VSE analysis capability [19].
For CMP180 hardware/performance claims, use formal CMP180 specifications showing simultaneous receiver and transmitter testing and optional multiport RF generator/analyzer architecture [20].
For competitor-side claims, use competitor official datasheets, configuration guides, order/configurator data, service terms, conformance/accreditation reports, or other cited third-party evidence rather than only R&S battle cards, because the Keysight battle-card language says “only,” “fully integrated,” scalability, and TCO claims require formal datasheet, features document, conformance report, or configurator verification [28].
For Anritsu comparisons, do not rely only on the R&S battle card for FR1 bandwidth, FR2 instantaneous bandwidth, FR3/RFU18 headroom, or data-rate numbers, because those are marked as sales claims at a different evidence level than formal CMX500 specifications [32].
For Amarisoft comparisons, do not present support, FR2, conformance, production-path, or other competitive claims as verified unless backed by official or third-party evidence, because the Amarisoft comparison table notes the battle card does not cite third-party or Amarisoft official documents for some claims [12].
For FR3/RFU18-related comparisons, obtain RFU18 datasheet/configurator evidence before making binding specification claims, because current sources lack RFU18 order number, formal specs document number, release date, supported configurations, bandwidth, throughput, MCS index, software release, and measurement conditions [17].
